notes:
SUMMARY: Enterprise research portal for sell-side research and internal analyst knowledge base. Primary focus: large-scale embeddings + reranking for precision search (RAG) with strict residency/KMS. Dedicated capacity preferred for isolation, predictable latency, and customer-managed keys.

Key requirements (from SE call):
- Index scale: initial corpus 80M docs, growth plan to 200-400M (pdfs, research notes, time-series snippets).
- Embeddings: prefer 1536-d / 768-d vector space; want flexibility to host custom embedding model or use Redwood-verified open models.
- Reranking: two-stage pipeline (dense retrieval -> learned reranker). Need top-100 re-rank within 120-200ms P95 on dedicated hardware.
- Latency targets: cold-query P95 <= 200ms (exclude network), P99 SLO 350ms for enterprise tier.
- Cost target: blended cost per query < $0.01 at 100 QPS baseline with heavy caching and batching.
- Security: must support customer-managed KMS/HSM, SSO (SAML + SCIM), audit logs retention 7 years, SOC2 + ISO27001.
- Data residency: primary copies in US-East; replicas for DR in eu-west only with contractual clauses.
- Deployment: lean toward Redwood Dedicated with VPC, but open to Private on-prem bundle if legal requires full air-gap for certain datasets.
- Operational: need token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, and traceability for model version used per response.

Quotes & paraphrases:
- "If we can't prove where our embeddings live and who can decrypt them, legal won't sign." - Head of Security (TrustHarbor)
- "Reranker quality has to beat our in-house BERT baseline on MRR; we'll provide eval set." - Lead ML Engineer

POC / success criteria (agreed):
- Ingest 25M docs, produce embeddings, show search + rerank latency at 50 QPS with P95 < 200ms.
- Reranker to demonstrate >= 8% lift in MRR vs baseline on provided set.
- Provide cost model showing path to <$0.01/query at 100 QPS with recommended batching/caching/quantization.

Risks & concerns:
- Quantized open LLMs must meet fidelity; team insisted on sample outputs for 10 key prompts.
- Legal needs architecture diagram for KMS + key rotation; timeline expected 3 weeks for review.

Artifacts shared: drive pricing deck (rev2), security FAQ, evaluation prompt set (private), Fireflies transcripts.
